context: Selling on 29 Sep on all three indices, then as much recovery; the buyers who joined were removed by a retracement, and NIFTY closed on a retracement at 22,680.90, just above its 22,650 support.
plan: BRANCHES FLIPPED FROM 29 SEP: flat to a small gap-down now means BUY, and a gap up SELL. The day's selling was matched by an equal recovery, and the buyers that recovery drew in were already removed by a retracement.
FLAT TO SMALL GAP DOWN -> BUY: the buyers who came in on the recovery have been retraced out, and the market is trying to go up again -- identify buying-side setups.

GAP UP -> SELL: he would normally keep the same plan, but no sellers' stops sit above to fuel a rise, and nobody is seated long to hunt. Others may buy a gap up, reading it as positive -- so identify selling-side setups there.
